name: logobench
description: Local-first logo review and brand-identity workbench: AI critique, palettes, type pairings, mockups and exports.
author: Ari

scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.start: npm run build -w web && npm run serve -w server
